method: REA Ghidra static analysis; keyword-import runtime not exercised

findings.claim: File Input option 1 opens KEY file through 0x1401b5f00; parser 0x1401b6520 resolves keyword IDs/categories and dispatches seven handler families.
Object handler 0x14038b8a0 reads object ID, obtains object through 0x14019ccc0, and writes name at +0x828 and internal type at +0xc, matching DB importer object layout.
Simulation handler writes application scalar fields and applies checks/defaults. Material and interaction handlers find or create records.
Wrapper conditionally calls finalization 0x1401d7f40, including material-reference handling and iteration over active objects.
Unknown keyword branch warns and skips remaining line, except special silent SRFNRG case. Read/data errors are reported. Not every input keyword is guaranteed to be accepted.

Special-command handler 0x140378e00 DBREAD branch calls DB importer 0x1401cc2a0. Other branches include recursive keyword-file reading and object transforms. Keyword import is not exclusively passive data loading.

limits: Not a runtime validation or round-trip equivalence test.
Exact merge/reset behavior, every finalization effect, and full command side effects have not been recovered.
